title: Cryptographically insecure random.choice() used to generate session IDs
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/session.py:L11 builds session identifiers using random.choice(); Python's random module is not cryptographically secure and its output is predictable, making session IDs guessable by an attacker who can observe prior values.

title: SHA-1 used for password hashing in password_hash()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/session.py:L15 returns hashlib.sha1 as the password digest; SHA-1 is a fast, cryptographically weak hash not designed for password storage and is vulnerable to brute-force and rainbow-table attacks.
